auth.signIn.heading: Welcome back.
auth.signIn.copy: Continue through cvhome's authorization server and return to your default market.
auth.signIn.point1: Single sign-on available on Scale plans.
auth.signIn.point2: Session history and device list live in your profile.
auth.signIn.point3: Support answers in under four hours on weekdays.
auth.signIn.oauthCopy: Sign in through cvhome UAA. Your organization, stores and permissions are resolved by the authorization server after the handoff.
auth.signIn.twoFactorNote: Two-factor authentication applies where your organization requires it.
auth.signUp.heading: Plant your flag.
auth.signUp.copy: Create the account, choose where you want to sell first, and your store is live before you finish reading this page.
auth.signUp.point1: One account, as many storefronts as your plan allows.
auth.signUp.point2: Regions, currencies and tax rules configured per store.
auth.signUp.point3: No card until the trial ends.
auth.signUp.name: Name

auth.signUp.passwordFallback: Enter a password with at least eight characters.
auth.signUp.queuedNote: Thanks - account creation is queued for the backend signup endpoint.
auth.signUp.legalNote: Free for 14 days. No card. Close the account and every store with it, whenever you like.

ready.title: Create your first store
ready.copy: Nothing else in cvhome works until a store exists — products, orders and payments all belong to one. Pick a region and a name; provisioning takes about a minute.
ready.meta: ~1 minute · you can create more later

plan.title: Your plan
plan.meta: 14 days left · no card on file

help.title: Want us to set the first store up with you?
help.copy: A 15-minute call covering regions, currency and catalogue import. Free on every plan.

hero.headline:
Sell anywhere.
Rule everywhere.
hero.copy: cvhome is the operating table for merchants who outgrew one storefront. Many markets, many languages, many currencies. One command.

story.heading: Most platforms give you a store. We give you a territory.

openMarket.title: Open a market in a minute
openMarket.copy: A new store is a decision, not a project. Choose where you want to sell and it is standing before the coffee cools.

localLanguage.title: Speak the local language
localLanguage.copy: Every word your customers read, in their language and their currency, without running four teams to keep it true.

oneSeat.title: One seat, every store
oneSeat.copy: Switch markets the way you switch tabs. The numbers, the orders and the shelves all answer to the same login.

marta.quote: We ran three storefronts on three different tools before this. Consolidating them took an afternoon, and I finally see one stock number instead of three that disagree.

tobias.quote: Opening a new market used to be a project with a budget. Now it is a form. The tax and currency rules come preconfigured per region, which is the part I dreaded.

amina.quote: Arabic and English side by side in the same product form is what sold us. Translators work in the admin directly instead of passing spreadsheets back and forth.

daniel.quote: Support answered a payout question in under two hours on a Saturday. That mattered more than any feature on the pricing page.

camille.quote: The storefront builder gave us something on brand without a developer. We hired one later for the checkout, not for the basics.

priya.quote: Banners, pages and FAQ entries all publish per store per language. Our seasonal campaigns went from a two-week scramble to a Monday morning.

quote.text: “We opened Germany on a Tuesday morning and took our first order before lunch.”
quote.attribution: Head of Commerce · Acme Supply Holdings

pricing.heading: One price. Per store.
pricing.note: Every plan is the whole platform. The account is free — you only pay for stores you open.
